india.one_line: India's AI ecosystem expands with new models, policy steps, and industry growth.

themes.title: Chariot releases multilingual speech model
themes.text: Chariot launched Chariot‑1‑ASR Realtime, a speech‑to‑text model supporting ten Indian languages and Indian English, reporting lower error rates across 79 public test sets.

stories.headline: Chariot launches real‑time speech model for 10 Indian languages

themes.title: India advances AI regulatory framework
themes.text: The government announced a consultation paper on AI legislation to be released in coming weeks, while SEBI outlined plans for a graded broker compliance framework, an AI sandbox for testing tools, and reforms for tokenised corporate bonds.

stories.headline: India to issue AI law consultation paper in coming weeks, says minister
SEBI to introduce graded broker compliance, AI sandbox, and corporate bond reforms

themes.title: Poland seeks deeper AI ties with India
themes.text: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk called for stronger AI, digital and space cooperation with India, proposing joint development projects and inviting Indian firms to joint ventures at the Global Investors Meet 2027.

stories.headline: Polish prime minister calls for deeper AI, digital and space cooperation with India

themes.title: Indian AI industry shows growth
themes.text: LTM opened the BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai for developing and validating AI solutions, and Infosys reported a 29% quarter‑on‑quarter increase in AI revenue, now accounting for 10.5% of total revenue, while lowering its FY27 growth outlook to 1‑2%.

stories.headline: LTM launches BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai
Infosys AI revenue rises 29% QoQ as FY27 growth guidance cut to 1-2%
